resolved_conflicts.explanation: firetower.org gives a 7x7 foot cab moved from Mount Wilson. A 1923 Oregonian account of the Mount Wilson tower describes its lookout house as six feet square. The figures do not match, and no source reconciles them. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: The Mount Wilson origin of the cab appears only on firetower.org; firelookout.com does not mention it, and the Mount Wilson page read does not mention Parkdale. The 1923 six-foot house on Mount Wilson conflicts with the 7x7 cab, and the story says so. No source describes the tower remains or whether the grounds are open to visitors; the NRHP listing covers the station building only. The brief's conflict note ('They share a register number') could not be confirmed: firetower.org lists Parkdale as US 635 and Palmer Peak as US 634. A Living New Deal page (403) and a search snippet calling the station the Parkdale Work Station were not read, so the current use of the station is not stated in the story.
